steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Rights and responsibilities are two sides of the same citizenship coin. Rights: what you are entitled to (vote, free speech, fair trial, education, healthcare). Responsibilities: what you owe to society (obey the law, pay taxes, vote, serve on a jury, respect others' rights). | Key Fact: Legal responsibilities: obey the law (criminal and civil law apply to all), pay taxes (income tax, VAT, council tax fund public services), and serve on a jury if called (criminal trials require 12 jurors to determine guilt).
